svg.title: Dance Vision 87.87 FM: an ANSI BBS login screen
svg.desc: A modem dials in and a 1990s ANSI screen draws itself: the DANCE VISION logo between bouncing VU meters, a phone sending only 33 joints through a websocket relay on port 8787, crowned with a pirate radio mast, to a TV studio where five stick figures dance under a hopping spotlight, a caller panel (no video, no app, no account, 6 phones a room), tonight's line-up of six East London venues, a blinking PRESS ANY KEY, a shout-out scroller and the quick start command npm run party.
